does: The main menu page's command run when the page is Loaded (MainMenu.xaml): when ShowFirstTimeSetup is set, clears it and the graphic settings' calibration flag (ShowGammaCalibration, or ShowHDRCalibration on an HDR display), then saves the graphic settings and the profile's config.

evidence.says: with ShowFirstTimeSetup set in memory, the copy's flag stayed true through Eula, SensitiveSettings, GammaCalibration and SplashScreen and read false right after the MainMenu state was entered; config.lsf was rewritten in the same second
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
